title: What Happens to Your Prompt Before an AI Replies
description:
Your prompt is chopped into tokens, turned into numbers, passed through transformer layers, and the reply is written one token at a time.

The tokens, numbers and layers shown are illustrative. Inspired by @AstroTheWizard's whimsical "journey of photons" explainer prompt (yihui-dev/awesome-opus5-5-videos). Narration is a synthetic voice (VoiceStudio). Animation is written as code.
